content.user_title: Create and Share a Friendship Quiz
content.value_statement: Preparing a friendship quiz requires collecting real preferences and mapping each choice to the correct answer. This skill guides ten preset choices, previews a local draft, and optionally publishes through Block You Test Me.
actual_capabilities: Guide users through ten preset friendship questions with four choices each, using their stated preferences.
Convert numbered choices into validated answer indices and preview the selected answers locally without network requests.
Optionally submit a nickname and ten selected answers to the documented hosting endpoint when publication is requested.
Reject returned links with unexpected origins, paths, credentials, or query strings before adding a supported display language.
Add one of 25 supported display-language codes to returned quiz and management links.
Prepare public invitation text or provide choices for manual website entry when the helper is unavailable.
limitations: Questions are fixed; the skill does not create custom-topic exams, edit questions, or assess personality.
Automated publishing requires Node.js 18+, network access, and a working external service; offline tests do not establish live availability.
Publishing sends the nickname and selected answers to Block You Test Me; website storage and deletion depend on that service.
Anyone holding the private management link can view submitted nicknames and scores and delete the quiz.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Quiz for Friends
use_cases.description: Answer the preset questions, review your selected preferences, and request a hosted challenge for friends to play.
use_cases.target_user: Individuals organizing a casual friendship game

use_cases.title: Draft a Group Invitation
use_cases.description: Prepare a friendly invitation containing only the public challenge link while keeping score management access private.
use_cases.target_user: Community organizers running informal social activities

use_cases.title: Select a Display Language
use_cases.description: Choose a supported website language for quiz links without changing the creator nickname, answer indices, or scoring rules.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Local Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a friendship quiz using the ten preset questions. Ask for my nickname and choices in small batches. Do not publish.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect preferences without sending data to the website.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Choices
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my nickname [nickname] and ten choices [choices] against the preset question order. Clarify missing answers and preview locally without publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: validate an existing answer set.

prompt_templates.title: Publish and Prepare an Invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my completed draft, then publish on Block You Test Me. I authorize sending my nickname and answers. Keep private access outside the invitation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: publish an approved draft and separate public sharing from private management.

prompt_templates.title: Publish in a Supported Language
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate my draft for [language]. Publish only after my approval. Verify both returned links and avoid automatic retries. Offer manual entry if blocked.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: handle language selection and uncertain publication outcomes.

output_examples.input: Preview my completed draft as Alex, with Tea selected for the drink question. Do not publish.
output: The draft remains local. No hosting request was made.

output_examples.input: The hosting request was blocked. Help me continue without retrying.
output: Quiz creation was not verified. No automatic retry was made.
Open the Block You Test Me homepage and enter your prepared nickname and choices manually.
Share only the public friend link after creation. Keep the Friend Score Page private.

best_practices: Review all ten choices with the user and confirm consent before sending the nickname and answers for hosting.
Use a nickname suitable for public display and keep the private management link outside invitations, screenshots, and repositories.
Preview locally first and recheck current documentation when the question set or API behavior differs.
anti_patterns: Inventing missing personal preferences or presenting the game as a personality assessment.
Publishing a draft without authorization or sharing its private management link with friends.
Automatically retrying uncertain creation requests or claiming publication succeeded without a verified response.

faq.question: Can I create custom questions or educational exams?
faq.answer: No. The workflow uses ten preset friendship questions with four choices each. It does not support custom-topic exams or personality assessments.

faq.question: Can I prepare a quiz without sending data?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper previews and validates drafts locally by default. Its command-line interface sends a hosting request only with the explicit publish option.

faq.question: What information is sent when I publish?
faq.answer: The helper sends your nickname and ten selected answer indices to Block You Test Me. It requires no account or API key.

faq.question: Which link should I share with friends?
faq.answer: Share only the public friend link. Anyone with the private Friend Score Page link can view submitted nicknames and scores and delete the quiz.

faq.question: What happens if automated publishing fails?
faq.answer: Do not automatically retry or assume creation succeeded. The assistant can provide the homepage and prepared choices for manual entry.

faq.question: Does the skill support other languages?
faq.answer: The helper supports 25 display-language codes for website links. Changing the language preserves nicknames, identifiers, answer indices, and scoring rules.
